process_summary: The process begins with the SRM Operations Team performing the following SRM activities in strict order: SRM: Created, SRM: Complete, SRM: Waiting for Approval, and SRM: Document Complete. Once these activities are completed, proceed with SRM: In Transfer to Execution System and SRM: Ordered, which can be executed in parallel. Both must be completed before continuing. All SRM-related steps mostly involve simple system clicks and are typically quick to perform. Next, the Purchasing and Receiving Team Create Purchase Order Item. Parallel to this activity, the SRM Operation Team can carry on the activity SRM: Change was Transmitted. After these two activities are done, and after the goods arrive, the Purchasing and Receiving Team will Record Goods Receipt. Concurrently, the Invoice Recording Team records the Invoice Receipt, which may occur either before or after the goods receipt, but both activities must be completed before moving forward. After these steps, any existing payment blocks should be checked and removed if present. The process concludes with the Invoice Clearing Team completing Clear Invoice.
organization_summary: The organization is a company based in the Netherlands, specializing in coatings and paints. It has a distinctly international culture, with a relatively high proportion of foreign employees. The company values age diversity, employing people across various experience levels—from junior to senior. Both part-time and full-time work arrangements are supported
